title: OVHcloud
description: Configuration variables for OVHcloud CLI (ovhcloud) and Public Cloud compute/network driver

OVH_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install ovhcloud. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, and 'from-source' compiles from source.

OVH_VERSION.description: Specific version of ovhcloud to install.

OVH_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading ovhcloud binary or archive artifacts.

OVH_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying ovhcloud available remote releases.

OVH_REGION.description: Default OVHcloud Public Cloud region (e.g., GRA11, BHS5, SBG5).

OVH_PROJECT_ID.description: Default OVHcloud Public Cloud project serviceName / ID.

OVH_FLAVOR.description: Default OVHcloud Public Cloud compute flavor.
